must_not: The old photo back after a reload

steps.action: Open 'Edit page', un-tick every day, tap 'Save page'
user_sees: Every day reads 'Working hours not set'; every time can be booked with no outside-hours question
must_not: Every day read as 'Day off' (that would block nothing but says the wrong thing)

steps.action: Open 'Edit page', change things, tap 'Cancel'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the page is unchanged; opening the sheet again shows the saved values
must_not: The dropped changes saved
The dropped photo shown on the page

start: Privacy and promise: a trainer’s photo and words are shown to members and the desk

steps.action: Read the hint under 'What they teach' before saving
user_sees: 'Members and the desk see this. At most 80 letters.'
must_not: A photo or words shown to members with no word about it on the edit sheet

steps.action: Remove the photo and save, then look wherever the photo was shown
user_sees: Initials everywhere
must_not: The removed photo still kept or still shown to members

note: 'What they teach' is cut to 80 letters at save; an emoji counts as more than one letter in that cut

why_not: hours are weekly clock times with no date; the time-zone side bites where they are read (F-panel-330, F-panel-331)
note: none
Closing the sheet drops typed changes with no question; the owner and the trainer saving the same page: the last save wins
'Add a photo' opens the device’s picture chooser; all words are plain English strings
Seven day buttons wrap; shift pickers sit two to a row down to 130 px each
Hours saved day by day (by another tool or version) are flattened to one pattern by this form
What members see of the saved photo and words in the app was not read

title: On a trainer's page showing a past week, the booking sheet offers only a day that is already over
what: On a trainer's page, after pressing 'Last week', the button 'Book with <name>' opens a booking sheet whose Day list holds one day only, the Monday of that past week. Every try ends with 'This time has already passed', and the day cannot be changed. The same button under the main calendar handles this and offers today.
expected: The sheet opens on today (or the next day that can be booked), as it does from the main calendar.
who: owners and desk staff of gyms with trainer pages switched on
how_often: each time a booking is started while an earlier week is shown on a trainer's page
fix_line: Open the sheet on today when the shown week is already over
